== Usage ==
The license value inserted when a contributor picks '''"Public domain"''' from the Licensing dropdown on <code>Special:Upload</code>. Genuinely rare on this wiki — almost nothing related to ''Elite Dangerous'' itself qualifies. Don't use this as a fallback for "I don't know the license."

The outer notice uses the <code>noexcerpt</code> class so maintenance/editorial
text is excluded from article excerpts and Page Previews.
